changelog:
Version 7.9.6

Changed

  • Lab and Maximum presets: the above-the-fold layout styles now copy only rules that can apply to the first screen, with a larger budget, so a form or menu near the top of a page paints at its final size instead of jumping when the full stylesheets arrive. Takes effect when the preset is applied, or with the "Strict above-the-fold styles" setting in Configure.
